本次结果

退款金额：未裁定 SGD · 页面只展示建议，不执行收费或退款。

  • Reported road-route deviation is 4.3 km, which exceeds the mandatory 2.0 km autonomous threshold under Section 6.2, legally requiring human review.
  • Lack of independent historical traffic API provenance for traffic records TC-001 and TC-002 under Section 1.4.
  • Absence of contemporaneous trip call audio recordings to determine whether verbal route deviation notification or rider agreement occurred per Section 1.2 and Section 1.4.
  • Both advocates agree that Section 6.2 requires human review because the excess route distance of 4.3 km exceeds 2.0 km.
  • No safety indicators were flagged in this case.

Judge 如何看双方观点

以下为通过结构和引用检查的分析；这些检查不能证明自然语言推理正确。

核心问题

Whether the driver's route deviation of 4.3 km and resulting fare increase can be autonomously resolved under Policy v2.1 or must be escalated to human review due to the 2.0 km route deviation threshold.

乘客观点 · 部分有依据支持

The rider side correctly notes the reported 4.3 km excess road distance and identifies that Section 6.2 mandates human review for deviations over 2 km, though the claim of lack of verbal notice remains unverified due to missing call records.

裁决关键条件

  • route_justification · 满足

    Supplied traffic incident records TC-001 and TC-002 document a vehicle fire and severe congestion on the eastbound PIE during the trip window.

    E-040 E-041 E-042 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • distance_tolerance · 不满足

    Reported road route distance is 24.8 km vs 20.5 km recommended, creating a 4.3 km excess distance that exceeds the 1.0 km policy tolerance.

    E-035 E-040 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • timely_route_notice · 未知

    In-app chat contains no prior route notice, but call recordings are missing, leaving verbal notification under Section 1.2 unverified.

    E-023 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2
  • rider_acknowledgment · 未知

    No in-app acknowledgment is recorded, and verbal communication cannot be verified without trip audio recordings.

    E-023 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • extra_charge · 未知

    While Section 1.3 outlines refund rules, the dispute exceeds the Section 6.2 2.0 km autonomous threshold, barring agent determination.

    E-027 E-035 E-040 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2

争议点分析

  • Mandatory human review gate under Section 6.2 for route deviations over 2 km

    Section 6.2 sets a strict hard limit that route deviation cases can only be decided autonomously if deviation is 2 km or less. The reported excess distance is 4.3 km (24.8 km minus 20.5 km), which triggers mandatory escalation.

    E-035 E-040 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2
  • Substantiation of traffic justification and verbal route notification

    Traffic conditions TC-001 and TC-002 show congestion on the PIE, but external API provenance is unauthenticated under Section 1.4, and the lack of in-trip audio recordings prevents determining whether verbal notice was provided under Section 1.2.

    E-023 E-024 E-041 E-042 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4

复核问题逐项处理

  • ROUTE_JUSTIFICATION_REQUIRES_REVIEW · 仍待澄清

    Traffic incident records exist in the sample, but verification of actual rider notification and charging entitlement requires human review in light of the excess distance gate.

    E-023 E-024 E-041 E-042 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • TRAFFIC_API_PROVENANCE_MISSING · 仍待澄清

    The case records provide traffic data, but historical traffic API provenance is not independently certified per Section 1.4.

    E-041 E-042 E-043 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • VERBAL_ROUTE_NOTICE_RECORD_MISSING · 仍待澄清

    No call recordings are present in the record to verify or disprove verbal route deviation notification or rider acknowledgment under Section 1.2 and Section 1.4.

    E-023 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • ROUTE_DISTANCE_REQUIRES_HUMAN_REVIEW · 仍待澄清

    The reported road route deviation is 4.3 km, exceeding the 2.0 km threshold under Section 6.2 and mandating human escalation.

    E-035 E-040 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2

仍需补充的信息

  • Official historical traffic API authentication records verifying incidents TC-001 and TC-002 per Section 1.4.
  • Trip call audio recordings or contemporaneous in-vehicle communication logs to establish whether verbal notice was given or agreed to per Section 1.2.
  • Human reviewer adjudication of the route deviation exceeding 2.0 km pursuant to Section 6.2.

先例对照

  • P-RYDE-2.1-S7.1

    相似点：Both cases involve a driver rerouting due to traffic congestion on the recommended path, with no prior in-app notification given to the rider.

    差异：In precedent DISP-2026-0089, the route deviation was 1.8 km (allowing an autonomous ruling under Section 6.2), whereas here the deviation is 4.3 km, exceeding the 2.0 km threshold and requiring mandatory human escalation.

本次绑定的政策与程序检查

RYDE-POLICY-V2.1 · 生效 2026-01-01

人工审核门槛

  • ROUTE_DISTANCE_REQUIRES_HUMAN_REVIEW Section 6.2 requires human review when reported route deviation exceeds 2 km, regardless of a possible refund rationale. P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2

逐项政策条件

  • route_justification · met

    Supplied historical incident records overlap the recommended route/time; they are not independently authenticated API responses.

    E-028 E-030 E-031 E-040 E-041 E-042 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • distance_tolerance · not_met

    Use reported road-route kilometres; at most one excess kilometre is within the listed tolerance.

    E-035 E-040 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • timely_route_notice · unknown

    Recorded driver notice contains route change/reason and is no later than the observed deviation (or before trip start). Missing call recordings do not prove no verbal notice.

    P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2
  • rider_acknowledgment · unknown

    Explicit contextual rider acknowledgment can establish agreement; generic thanks or missing logs cannot.

    P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • extra_charge · unknown

    Route tolerance/justification and notification must be assessed separately from charging entitlement.

    E-035 E-040 E-041 E-042 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4

乘客 Advocate

第一轮陈述

  • The rider stated that the driver took an unnotified alternate route via Geylang and East Coast area, resulting in 4.3 km of extra distance and an overcharge. E-002 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1
  • The reported trip distance was 24.8 km compared to the recommended direct route of 20.5 km, generating an excess distance of 4.3 km and an excess fare of $6.50. E-034 E-035 E-036 E-037 E-038 E-039 E-040 E-044 E-045 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • In-app chat records show that when the rider questioned the route at 13:24:00, the driver provided a generic reassurance without giving a traffic reason or prior notice before deviating. E-023 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2
  • Because the excess route distance of 4.3 km exceeds the 2 km threshold, Section 6.2 mandates escalation to human review rather than an automated agent ruling. E-036 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2
  • Under Section 1.3, if traffic justification is recognized but the rider was not informed per Section 1.2, the rider is entitled to a partial refund of the excess distance fare ($3.44), or a full refund of excess distance fare if traffic justification is rejected. E-027 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S7.1
  • Organizer-supplied traffic incident records report a vehicle fire and heavy congestion on the PIE eastbound during the trip window, which could provide traffic justification for rerouting. E-041 E-042 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • The supplied records lack in-trip verbal call audio, so absence of verbal notification cannot be definitively proven from the chat log alone, though no verbal notice was acknowledged by the rider. E-002 E-023 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • Independent historical traffic API authentication records to formally substantiate the PIE incident under Section 1.4.
  • Trip call recording or in-vehicle audio logs to confirm whether any verbal notification of deviation was given to and acknowledged by the rider.
  • Human reviewer determination regarding the excess route distance exceeding 2 km pursuant to Section 6.2.

回应对方

  • The rider stated that the driver took an unnotified alternate route via Geylang and East Coast area, resulting in 4.3 km of excess distance and an overcharge. E-002 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1
  • Reported road distance records show the trip covered 24.8 km compared to the recommended 20.5 km route, producing an excess distance of 4.3 km (well beyond the 1.0 km tolerance) and a total fare difference of $6.50. E-027 E-034 E-035 E-036 E-037 E-038 E-039 E-040 E-044 E-045 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • Section 1.2 requires the driver to inform the rider before or at the deviation point with a brief reason; however, the in-app chat shows the driver provided only generic reassurance at 13:25:00 after the rider inquired at 13:24:00, with no advance notice or traffic explanation recorded. E-023 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2
  • Because the reported route deviation of 4.3 km exceeds the 2.0 km threshold defined in Section 6.2, an automated resolution cannot be executed and mandatory escalation to human review is required. E-036 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2
  • Under Section 1.3, if the reviewer determines the reroute was justified by traffic but unnotified, the rider is entitled to a partial refund of the excess distance fare ($3.44), whereas if traffic justification is rejected due to unauthenticated records, the full excess distance fare ($3.44) is refundable. E-027 E-041 E-042 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4 P-RYDE-2.1-S7.1
  • While the driver advocate argues the reroute was justified by severe traffic on the PIE corridor, the supplied traffic records are organizer-provided samples lacking independent historical traffic API authentication as required by Section 1.4. E-041 E-042 E-043 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • Even if the human reviewer accepts the traffic justification and notes the trip duration was 37 minutes, traffic justification alone does not eliminate the Section 1.2 notification requirement nor exempt the driver from excess distance fare refund rules under Section 1.3. E-032 E-033 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3
  • The driver side correctly notes that missing in-trip call recordings do not disprove verbal notice; however, the supplied records contain no proof of verbal disclosure or rider agreement. E-023 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • Independent historical traffic API provenance or authenticated source verification for incidents TC-001 and TC-002 per Section 1.4.
  • Trip call audio recordings or contemporaneous communication records to evaluate whether verbal notice and rider acknowledgment occurred per Section 1.2 and Section 1.4.

司机 Advocate

第一轮陈述

  • The driver's rerouting was justified by active, severe traffic incidents on the recommended PIE corridor during the trip window. E-040 E-041 E-042 E-043 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • The driver completed the trip promptly in 37 minutes, compared to the estimated 35 minutes, successfully avoiding the severe congestion on the PIE to deliver the rider on time for their scheduled flight. E-021 E-031 E-032 E-033 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1
  • Under policy section 1.3, even when a driver reroutes for traffic without recorded prior notification, the rider is only eligible for a partial refund of the excess distance fare ($3.44), not a refund of the entire fare difference ($6.50) or trip. E-027 E-039 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S7.1
  • Because the reported route deviation of 4.3 km exceeds the 2.0 km threshold, Section 6.2 mandates escalation to human review, precluding an automated resolution. E-036 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2
  • The rider stated that the driver did not inform them of any route change or traffic, and the in-app chat does not record an advance traffic explanation prior to rerouting. E-002 E-023 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2
  • The supplied records do not include an in-trip call recording to verify whether verbal notice or agreement occurred as permitted under section 1.2. E-023 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • Trip call audio recording or in-person verbal communication verification to determine whether verbal notice of the reroute was given at or before the deviation point per Section 1.2.
  • Official historical traffic API authentication records to independently verify the provenance of incidents TC-001 and TC-002 per Section 1.4.

回应对方

  • The driver's deviation from the PIE was justified under Section 1.1 by documented severe traffic conditions, specifically an active vehicle fire blocking lanes 1 and 2 on the recommended PIE eastbound corridor during the trip window. E-040 E-041 E-042 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • The alternate route successfully avoided substantial congestion and delivered the rider to Changi Airport T3 in 37 minutes, just 2 minutes over the estimated 35-minute duration, ensuring timely arrival for the rider's 15:30 flight. E-021 E-031 E-032 E-033 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1
  • Because the reported route deviation of 4.3 km exceeds the 2 km threshold specified in Section 6.2, mandatory policy rules require escalating this dispute to human review rather than executing an automated agent refund. E-036 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2
  • Under Section 1.3, where traffic justification exists, lack of written chat notification limits any potential rider remedy to a partial refund of the excess distance fare ($3.44), precluding the rider's demand for a full excess fare refund of $6.50 or any trip refund. E-027 E-039 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S7.1
  • While the rider asserts no route change notification was provided and in-app chat does not record an advance traffic explanation, Section 1.2 permits verbal notification, and the absence of trip call or in-cabin audio recordings means verbal communication cannot be conclusively proven or disproven. E-002 E-023 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2
  • The rider's reliance on a $6.50 overcharge claim conflates the total fare difference with the excess distance fare component, which is recorded as only $3.44 alongside $2.22 in excess tolls. E-027 E-039 E-045 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3
  • Independent historical traffic API provenance or authenticated source logs to formally verify the PIE incident under Section 1.4.
  • Trip call audio recordings or in-vehicle communication records to determine whether verbal notice and acknowledgment occurred pursuant to Section 1.2 and Section 1.4.
  • Human reviewer determination regarding the excess route deviation exceeding 2 km pursuant to Section 6.2.

政策与原文

P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1 Section 1.1: General Principle

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §1.1 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/1.1",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "General Principle",
      "text": "Drivers are permitted to reroute from the GPS-recommended path in response to real-time traffic conditions, road closures, or congestion. However, the rider must be informed of any deviation.",
      "line_start": 12,
      "line_end": 14
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2 Section 1.2: Notification Requirement

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §1.2 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/1.2",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Notification Requirement",
      "text": "- The driver **MUST** inform the rider of a route deviation via **in-app chat** or **verbally** (with the trip call recording as evidence) **before or at the point of deviation**.\n- A brief reason (e.g., \"traffic jam ahead onNicoll Highway, taking alternate route\") is sufficient.",
      "line_start": 16,
      "line_end": 19
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3 Section 1.3: Refund Eligibility Matrix

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §1.3 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/1.3",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Refund Eligibility Matrix",
      "text": "| Scenario | Rider Informed? | Deviation > 1km? | Refund |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider informed and agrees | Yes | Yes | No refund |\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider **not** informed | No | Yes | Partial refund of excess distance fare |\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider not informed | No | No (≤ 1km) | No refund (within tolerance) |\n| Driver reroutes **without** traffic justification (no evidence of congestion) | N/A | Yes | **Full refund** of excess distance fare |\n| Driver reroutes without justification, deviation ≤ 1km | N/A | No | No refund (within tolerance) |",
      "line_start": 21,
      "line_end": 29
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4 Section 1.4: Evidence Requirements

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §1.4 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/1.4",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Evidence Requirements",
      "text": "- Traffic justification is verified via **historical traffic API data** for the route segment at the trip time.\n- Route deviation distance is calculated as: `actual_route_distance − recommended_route_distance`.\n- If the driver's in-app chat or call recording confirms rider acknowledgment, the deviation is considered agreed.",
      "line_start": 31,
      "line_end": 35
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S5.1 Section 5.1: Automatic Escalation

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.1 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/5.1",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Automatic Escalation",
      "text": "Any dispute flagged as **safety-related** is **automatically escalated to human review**. Safety-related disputes include but are not limited to:\n\n- Reckless or dangerous driving.\n- Physical or verbal harassment.\n- Assault or threat of assault.\n- Inappropriate behavior or conduct.\n- Traffic accidents during the trip.\n- Rider or driver feeling unsafe during the trip.",
      "line_start": 152,
      "line_end": 161
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S5.2 Section 5.2: AI Agent Limitations

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.2 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/5.2",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "AI Agent Limitations",
      "text": "- AI agents (Rider Advocate, Driver Advocate, Judge) **MAY** gather evidence, summarize accounts, and prepare case files for human reviewers.\n- AI agents **CANNOT** issue rulings, determine fault, or recommend resolutions on safety incidents.\n- AI agents **MUST** flag any dispute that contains safety-related keywords or indicators for immediate human escalation, regardless of the dispute type selected by the filer.",
      "line_start": 163,
      "line_end": 167
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S5.3 Section 5.3: Interim Measures

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.3 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/5.3",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Interim Measures",
      "text": "Upon escalation, the system may apply interim measures pending human review:\n\n- Temporary suspension of the accused party's account.\n- Prevention of new trip acceptance (for drivers) or booking (for riders).\n- These measures are lifted if the human reviewer determines no safety violation occurred.",
      "line_start": 169,
      "line_end": 175
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S6.1 Section 6.1: Monetary Thresholds

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.1 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/6.1",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Monetary Thresholds",
      "text": "| Dispute Value | Ruling Path | Agent Confidence Requirement |\n|---|---|---|\n| Under $10 | AI agent ruling is **final** | Any confidence level |\n| $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling with **80%+ confidence** | If confidence < 80%, escalate to human review |\n| Above $50 | **Always human review** | N/A — AI agent prepares case file only |",
      "line_start": 181,
      "line_end": 187
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2 Section 6.2: Category Thresholds

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.2 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/6.2",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Category Thresholds",
      "text": "| Dispute Category | Ruling Path |\n|---|---|\n| Safety incident | **Always human review** (see Section 5) |\n| Fare dispute < $10 | AI agent ruling is final |\n| Fare dispute $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80%, else escalate |\n| Fare dispute > $50 | Always human review |\n| Route deviation | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80% and deviation ≤ 2km, else escalate |\n| Property damage (cleaning ≤ $50) | AI agent ruling if photo evidence is verifiable |\n| Property damage (repair > $50) | Always human review |\n| No-show / cancellation | AI agent ruling is final (fee is fixed at $5.00) |",
      "line_start": 189,
      "line_end": 200
    }
  }
]

[

      "policy": [
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1",
          "rule": "Section 1.1: General Principle\nDrivers are permitted to reroute from the GPS-recommended path in response to real-time traffic conditions, road closures, or congestion. However, the rider must be informed of any deviation.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §1.1"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2",
          "rule": "Section 1.2: Notification Requirement\n- The driver **MUST** inform the rider of a route deviation via **in-app chat** or **verbally** (with the trip call recording as evidence) **before or at the point of deviation**.\n- A brief reason (e.g., \"traffic jam ahead onNicoll Highway, taking alternate route\") is sufficient.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §1.2"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3",
          "rule": "Section 1.3: Refund Eligibility Matrix\n| Scenario | Rider Informed? | Deviation > 1km? | Refund |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider informed and agrees | Yes | Yes | No refund |\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider **not** informed | No | Yes | Partial refund of excess distance fare |\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider not informed | No | No (≤ 1km) | No refund (within tolerance) |\n| Driver reroutes **without** traffic justification (no evidence of congestion) | N/A | Yes | **Full refund** of excess distance fare |\n| Driver reroutes without justification, deviation ≤ 1km | N/A | No | No refund (within tolerance) |",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §1.3"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4",
          "rule": "Section 1.4: Evidence Requirements\n- Traffic justification is verified via **historical traffic API data** for the route segment at the trip time.\n- Route deviation distance is calculated as: `actual_route_distance − recommended_route_distance`.\n- If the driver's in-app chat or call recording confirms rider acknowledgment, the deviation is considered agreed.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §1.4"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S5.1",
          "rule": "Section 5.1: Automatic Escalation\nAny dispute flagged as **safety-related** is **automatically escalated to human review**. Safety-related disputes include but are not limited to:\n\n- Reckless or dangerous driving.\n- Physical or verbal harassment.\n- Assault or threat of assault.\n- Inappropriate behavior or conduct.\n- Traffic accidents during the trip.\n- Rider or driver feeling unsafe during the trip.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.1"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S5.2",
          "rule": "Section 5.2: AI Agent Limitations\n- AI agents (Rider Advocate, Driver Advocate, Judge) **MAY** gather evidence, summarize accounts, and prepare case files for human reviewers.\n- AI agents **CANNOT** issue rulings, determine fault, or recommend resolutions on safety incidents.\n- AI agents **MUST** flag any dispute that contains safety-related keywords or indicators for immediate human escalation, regardless of the dispute type selected by the filer.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.2"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S5.3",
          "rule": "Section 5.3: Interim Measures\nUpon escalation, the system may apply interim measures pending human review:\n\n- Temporary suspension of the accused party's account.\n- Prevention of new trip acceptance (for drivers) or booking (for riders).\n- These measures are lifted if the human reviewer determines no safety violation occurred.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.3"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S6.1",
          "rule": "Section 6.1: Monetary Thresholds\n| Dispute Value | Ruling Path | Agent Confidence Requirement |\n|---|---|---|\n| Under $10 | AI agent ruling is **final** | Any confidence level |\n| $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling with **80%+ confidence** | If confidence < 80%, escalate to human review |\n| Above $50 | **Always human review** | N/A — AI agent prepares case file only |",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.1"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2",
          "rule": "Section 6.2: Category Thresholds\n| Dispute Category | Ruling Path |\n|---|---|\n| Safety incident | **Always human review** (see Section 5) |\n| Fare dispute < $10 | AI agent ruling is final |\n| Fare dispute $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80%, else escalate |\n| Fare dispute > $50 | Always human review |\n| Route deviation | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80% and deviation ≤ 2km, else escalate |\n| Property damage (cleaning ≤ $50) | AI agent ruling if photo evidence is verifiable |\n| Property damage (repair > $50) | Always human review |\n| No-show / cancellation | AI agent ruling is final (fee is fixed at $5.00) |",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.2"
        },

    "policy_documents": {
      "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1": {
        "document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
        "title": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1",
        "version": "2.1",
        "effective_date": "2026-01-01",
        "source": {
          "filename": "Document 2 — Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 (Markdown).md",
          "archive_path": "sources/official/2026-10-15/policy-v2.1.md",
          "file_sha256": "827c4d2cab2d4db9e176521000b079632bbe80c20f69c3ffd0addecc8cbc8699"
        },
        "sections": {
          "1.1": {
            "title": "General Principle",
            "text": "Drivers are permitted to reroute from the GPS-recommended path in response to real-time traffic conditions, road closures, or congestion. However, the rider must be informed of any deviation.",
            "line_start": 12,
            "line_end": 14
          },
          "1.2": {
            "title": "Notification Requirement",
            "text": "- The driver **MUST** inform the rider of a route deviation via **in-app chat** or **verbally** (with the trip call recording as evidence) **before or at the point of deviation**.\n- A brief reason (e.g., \"traffic jam ahead onNicoll Highway, taking alternate route\") is sufficient.",
            "line_start": 16,
            "line_end": 19
          },
          "1.3": {
            "title": "Refund Eligibility Matrix",
            "text": "| Scenario | Rider Informed? | Deviation > 1km? | Refund |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider informed and agrees | Yes | Yes | No refund |\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider **not** informed | No | Yes | Partial refund of excess distance fare |\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider not informed | No | No (≤ 1km) | No refund (within tolerance) |\n| Driver reroutes **without** traffic justification (no evidence of congestion) | N/A | Yes | **Full refund** of excess distance fare |\n| Driver reroutes without justification, deviation ≤ 1km | N/A | No | No refund (within tolerance) |",
            "line_start": 21,
            "line_end": 29
          },
          "1.4": {
            "title": "Evidence Requirements",
            "text": "- Traffic justification is verified via **historical traffic API data** for the route segment at the trip time.\n- Route deviation distance is calculated as: `actual_route_distance − recommended_route_distance`.\n- If the driver's in-app chat or call recording confirms rider acknowledgment, the deviation is considered agreed.",
            "line_start": 31,
            "line_end": 35
          },
          "2.1": {
            "title": "Free Wait Time",
            "text": "- The driver must wait at the pickup location for a **free wait time of 5 minutes** from the scheduled pickup time.\n- After 5 minutes, the driver may cancel the trip as a \"rider no-show.\"",
            "line_start": 41,
            "line_end": 44
          },
          "2.2": {
            "title": "Cancellation Fee",
            "text": "- A **no-show cancellation fee of $5.00** is charged to the rider when the driver cancels after the free wait period.\n- The cancellation fee is transferred to the driver as compensation for time and fuel.",
            "line_start": 46,
            "line_end": 49
          },
          "2.3": {
            "title": "Driver Contact Obligation",
            "text": "Before cancelling for no-show, the driver **MUST** attempt to contact the rider with:\n\n1. **At least 1 in-app chat message**, AND\n2. **At least 1 phone call** (via the in-app calling system).\n\nIf the driver fails to meet both contact obligations, the cancellation fee is **voided** and the rider is not charged.",
            "line_start": 51,
            "line_end": 58
          },
          "2.4": {
            "title": "Driver No-Show",
            "text": "- If the driver **fails to arrive at the pickup location** within a reasonable time (defined as scheduled pickup time + 5 minutes), the rider may cancel at no charge.\n- If the driver fails to arrive **and** fails to attempt contact, the rider is eligible for a **$5.00 goodwill credit**.",
            "line_start": 60,
            "line_end": 63
          },
          "2.5": {
            "title": "Repeat No-Show Flagging",
            "text": "- If a rider accumulates **3 or more no-show cancellations within a 30-day rolling window**, the rider's account is **flagged** for review.\n- Flagged accounts are subject to:\n  - Mandatory upfront payment for future bookings.\n  - Temporary suspension pending review by the Trust & Safety team.",
            "line_start": 65,
            "line_end": 70
          },
          "3.1": {
            "title": "Upfront Quote Binding",
            "text": "- The upfront quote presented to the rider at booking is **binding at the surge multiplier in effect at quote time** (typically 1.0x in normal conditions).\n- The quoted fare includes: base fare, distance fare, time fare, booking fee, and any applicable surge.",
            "line_start": 76,
            "line_end": 79
          },
          "3.2": {
            "title": "Surge Change Notification",
            "text": "- If the surge multiplier **increases** between the time of quote and the time of trip start, the rider **MUST be notified** via an **in-app notification** before or at the point of pickup.\n- The notification must clearly state:\n  - The new surge multiplier.\n  - The revised estimated fare.\n  - An option to cancel without penalty.",
            "line_start": 81,
            "line_end": 87
          },
          "3.3": {
            "title": "Refund Eligibility",
            "text": "| Scenario | Rider Notified? | Refund |\n|---|---|---|\n| Surge increases, rider notified, rider proceeds | Yes | No refund — higher fare applies |\n| Surge increases, rider **not** notified | No | **Full refund of the surge differential** (actual fare − quoted fare) |\n| Surge decreases between quote and trip start | N/A | Lower fare applies automatically (rider benefits) |\n| Surge unchanged | N/A | Quoted fare applies |",
            "line_start": 89,
            "line_end": 96
          },
          "3.4": {
            "title": "Surge Differential Calculation",
            "text": "```\nsurge_differential = actual_fare − upfront_quote\n```\n\nWhere the difference is attributable solely to a surge multiplier change (all other fare components unchanged), the full differential is refundable if the rider was not notified.",
            "line_start": 98,
            "line_end": 104
          },
          "3.5": {
            "title": "Surge-Exempt Components",
            "text": "The following fare components are **exempt** from surge pricing and remain fixed regardless of multiplier:\n\n- Booking fee\n\nAll other components (base fare, distance fare, time fare) are subject to the surge multiplier.",
            "line_start": 106,
            "line_end": 112
          },
          "4.1": {
            "title": "Driver Claim Rights",
            "text": "Drivers may file claims for cleaning or repair fees resulting from **rider-caused damage** to the vehicle, including but not limited to:\n\n- Spills, vomiting, or food/beverage stains.\n- Physical damage to interior (seats, doors, windows).\n- Damage to exterior caused by rider behavior during boarding/alighting.",
            "line_start": 118,
            "line_end": 124
          },
          "4.2": {
            "title": "Evidence Requirements",
            "text": "| Requirement | Details |\n|---|---|\n| Photo evidence | Must be submitted **within 24 hours** of trip completion |\n| Timestamps | Photos must be automatically timestamped by the in-app camera |\n| Verifiability | Photos must be verifiable — taken through the Ryde driver app's built-in camera, not external uploads |\n| Trip association | Damage must be linked to the specific trip via GPS telemetry and trip timestamp |",
            "line_start": 126,
            "line_end": 133
          },
          "4.3": {
            "title": "Fee Structure",
            "text": "| Damage Type | Maximum Fee | Conditions |\n|---|---|---|\n| Cleaning fee | Up to **$50.00** | Photo evidence of soiling/stain; no external quote required |\n| Repair fee | Cost of repair | Requires a **written quote from a certified workshop**; quote must be submitted within 7 days |",
            "line_start": 135,
            "line_end": 140
          },
          "4.4": {
            "title": "Dispute Handling",
            "text": "- If the rider disputes the damage claim, the dispute is routed to human review.\n- The driver's photo evidence and the rider's account are both reviewed.\n- If evidence is insufficient (no timestamp, external photo, or damage not linked to trip), the claim is **rejected**.",
            "line_start": 142,
            "line_end": 146
          },
          "5.1": {
            "title": "Automatic Escalation",
            "text": "Any dispute flagged as **safety-related** is **automatically escalated to human review**. Safety-related disputes include but are not limited to:\n\n- Reckless or dangerous driving.\n- Physical or verbal harassment.\n- Assault or threat of assault.\n- Inappropriate behavior or conduct.\n- Traffic accidents during the trip.\n- Rider or driver feeling unsafe during the trip.",
            "line_start": 152,
            "line_end": 161
          },
          "5.2": {
            "title": "AI Agent Limitations",
            "text": "- AI agents (Rider Advocate, Driver Advocate, Judge) **MAY** gather evidence, summarize accounts, and prepare case files for human reviewers.\n- AI agents **CANNOT** issue rulings, determine fault, or recommend resolutions on safety incidents.\n- AI agents **MUST** flag any dispute that contains safety-related keywords or indicators for immediate human escalation, regardless of the dispute type selected by the filer.",
            "line_start": 163,
            "line_end": 167
          },
          "5.3": {
            "title": "Interim Measures",
            "text": "Upon escalation, the system may apply interim measures pending human review:\n\n- Temporary suspension of the accused party's account.\n- Prevention of new trip acceptance (for drivers) or booking (for riders).\n- These measures are lifted if the human reviewer determines no safety violation occurred.",
            "line_start": 169,
            "line_end": 175
          },
          "6.1": {
            "title": "Monetary Thresholds",
            "text": "| Dispute Value | Ruling Path | Agent Confidence Requirement |\n|---|---|---|\n| Under $10 | AI agent ruling is **final** | Any confidence level |\n| $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling with **80%+ confidence** | If confidence < 80%, escalate to human review |\n| Above $50 | **Always human review** | N/A — AI agent prepares case file only |",
            "line_start": 181,
            "line_end": 187
          },
          "6.2": {
            "title": "Category Thresholds",
            "text": "| Dispute Category | Ruling Path |\n|---|---|\n| Safety incident | **Always human review** (see Section 5) |\n| Fare dispute < $10 | AI agent ruling is final |\n| Fare dispute $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80%, else escalate |\n| Fare dispute > $50 | Always human review |\n| Route deviation | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80% and deviation ≤ 2km, else escalate |\n| Property damage (cleaning ≤ $50) | AI agent ruling if photo evidence is verifiable |\n| Property damage (repair > $50) | Always human review |\n| No-show / cancellation | AI agent ruling is final (fee is fixed at $5.00) |",
            "line_start": 189,
            "line_end": 200
          },
          "6.3": {
            "title": "Confidence Calibration",
            "text": "- Agent confidence is calculated based on: evidence completeness, policy clarity, precedent alignment, and party credibility scores.\n- If any party has a fraud flag ≥ 1, the confidence threshold is raised to 95% regardless of dispute value.",
            "line_start": 202,
            "line_end": 205
          },
          "7.1": {
            "title": "Route Deviation Without Notification",
            "text": "| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Case ID** | DISP-2026-0089 |\n| **Date** | 2026-02-12 |\n| **Dispute Type** | route_deviation |\n| **Facts** | Driver rerouted from Geylang to Orchard via Nicoll Highway due to traffic. Deviation was 1.8km beyond recommended route. Rider was not informed. GPS telemetry confirmed traffic congestion on original route. |\n| **Ruling** | Partial refund of excess distance fare. Rationale: Driver had valid traffic justification (confirmed via traffic API), but failed to notify rider per Section 1.2. Refund applies only to the excess distance fare, not the entire trip. |\n| **Refund Amount** | $3.20 |\n| **Confidence** | 91% |",
            "line_start": 213,
            "line_end": 223
          },
          "7.2": {
            "title": "Surge Pricing Without Rider Notification",
            "text": "| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Case ID** | DISP-2026-0142 |\n| **Date** | 2026-04-03 |\n| **Dispute Type** | fare_dispute |\n| **Facts** | Rider received upfront quote of $9.50 at 1.0x surge. Surge increased to 1.4x between quote and pickup. Rider was not notified. Actual fare was $12.70 — a difference of $3.20 entirely attributable to surge differential. |\n| **Ruling** | Full refund of surge differential. Rationale: Per Section 3.3, if surge increases between quote and trip start and rider is not notified, rider is eligible for full refund of the surge differential. The $3.20 difference was solely attributable to surge multiplier change. |\n| **Refund Amount** | $3.20 |\n| **Confidence** | 96% |",
            "line_start": 225,
            "line_end": 235
          },
          "7.3": {
            "title": "No-Show Cancellation Without Contact Attempt",
            "text": "| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Case ID** | DISP-2026-0211 |\n| **Date** | 2026-05-18 |\n| **Dispute Type** | cancellation_fee |\n| **Facts** | Driver arrived at pickup, waited 6 minutes, and cancelled as no-show. $5.00 fee charged to rider. Review of chat logs and call records showed the driver sent zero messages and made zero calls before cancelling. Rider arrived at the pickup point 1 minute after cancellation. |\n| **Ruling** | Cancellation fee voided. Rationale: Per Section 2.3, the driver must attempt at least 1 in-app message and 1 call before cancelling for no-show. The driver failed to meet both contact obligations. The $5.00 fee is reversed and refunded to the rider. |\n| **Refund Amount** | $5.00 |\n| **Confidence** | 98% |",
            "line_start": 237,
            "line_end": 247
          }
        }
      }
    },

      },

        "question": "Route tolerance/justification and notification must be assessed separately from charging entitlement."
      }

  • 已保留的原始候选问题：论点的引用类型不满足所选判断范围。记录了某人的说法，不等于证实了所述事件。

核心问题

Central dispute: Whether the driver properly satisfied no-show cancellation requirements to uphold the $5.00 cancellation fee, or whether an unresolved conflict between the embedded 8-minute no-show threshold and standalone Policy v2.1 Section 2.1 (along with the 95% confidence requirement under Section 6.3) mandates human escalation.

乘客观点 · 部分有依据支持

The rider's arguments regarding the existence of an unresolved threshold clock conflict, mathematical elapsed time from scheduled pickup, and the elevated 95% confidence threshold under Section 6.3 are supported by records and audit findings, whereas the factual claim of driver absence is contradicted by telemetry and arrival records.

争议点分析

  • Governing no-show waiting clock and threshold precedence

    Embedded cancellation policy P-004 specifies an 8-minute no-show threshold, whereas Ryde Policy v2.1 Section 2.1 permits cancellation after 5 minutes of free wait from scheduled pickup. The trip cancelled 360 seconds (6 minutes) after scheduled pickup and 480 seconds (8 minutes) after driver arrival/wait start. Without an authoritative policy rule governing clock precedence, this discrepancy cannot be resolved by an automated decision.

    E-003 E-005 E-006 E-031 E-035 E-037 E-039 P-004 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.2
  • Driver arrival and lobby presence

    The rider stated the driver was absent at the pickup point, but GPS telemetry and auto-arrival event records verify the vehicle arrived within 10 meters of the pickup point at 08:43:00 at 0 km/h, contradicting the assertion that the driver never arrived.

    E-001 E-002 E-004 E-013 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.4

复核问题逐项处理

  • NO_SHOW_THRESHOLD_CLOCK_UNSPECIFIED · 仍待澄清

    Embedded policy rule P-004 references an 8-minute threshold without defining whether it triggers from driver arrival or scheduled pickup. Standalone Policy v2.1 Section 2.1 anchors free wait to scheduled pickup but does not define the separate embedded threshold clock.

    E-003 E-005 E-006 E-031 E-035 E-037 P-004 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1
  • POLICY_SOURCE_CONFLICT · 仍待澄清

    Embedded cancellation policy P-004 mandates an 8-minute no-show threshold while standalone Policy v2.1 Sections 2.1-2.2 permit cancellation after 5 minutes of free wait starting from scheduled pickup. Hierarchy between dataset policy and standalone policy is unspecified and cannot be inferred.

    E-003 E-006 E-037 E-039 P-004 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.2

仍需补充的信息

  • Official operational guidance or precedence ruling determining whether embedded rule P-004 (8 minutes) or standalone Policy v2.1 §2.1 (5 minutes from scheduled pickup) controls no-show cancellation fee entitlement.
  • Authoritative clock definition establishing the triggering start event for the 8-minute no-show threshold referenced in P-004 and app event E-031.

先例对照

  • P-RYDE-2.1-S7.3

    相似点：Both disputes involve a $5.00 no-show cancellation fee applied after driver waiting at pickup.

    差异：In precedent DISP-2026-0211, the driver sent zero messages and made zero calls, violating Section 2.3. In the present case, the driver fully satisfied Section 2.3 contact requirements by sending four messages and placing an in-app call.

本次绑定的政策与程序检查

RYDE-POLICY-V2.1 · 生效 2026-01-01

人工审核门槛

  • NO_SHOW_THRESHOLD_CLOCK_UNSPECIFIED The embedded no-show threshold has no defined start event. Section 2.1 defines free wait from scheduled pickup but does not define this separate threshold clock. P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1
  • POLICY_SOURCE_CONFLICT Embedded cancellation thresholds/fee differ from standalone v2.1 sections 2.1-2.2 (cancel after 5 free minutes from scheduled pickup; $5 fee). Source precedence is not supplied. Do not treat 5+8 as 13 or choose the favorable clock. P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.2

逐项政策条件

  • no_show_charge · unknown

    Fixed fee requires reconciled policy, sufficient scheduled free wait, arrival and both contact attempts.

    E-001 E-003 E-004 E-005 E-006 E-007 E-008 E-017 E-018 E-019 E-020 E-021 E-022 E-023 E-024 E-025 E-026 E-027 E-028 E-029 E-030 E-031 E-032 E-035 E-036 E-037 E-038 E-039 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.4
  • free_wait · met

    Five free minutes start at scheduled pickup; exact-boundary cancellation requires clarification.

    E-003 E-006 E-035 E-036 E-037 E-039 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1
  • driver_contact · met

    At least one in-app message AND one call attempt strictly before cancellation. Missing logs alone do not prove no attempt; conflicting complete summaries require review.

    E-017 E-018 E-019 E-020 E-021 E-029 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.3
  • driver_arrival · met

    Recorded arrival event corroborates timely arrival; driver messages alone are not location evidence.

    E-004 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.4

程序保留原输出，对不满足来源要求的论点降低支持评级，或按逐条评价修正汇总标签，然后重新检查全部规则。Fare 仅在政策条件及主依据独立成立时允许此修正；裁决与金额不变，未执行任何收费或退款。

第一轮陈述

  • The driver timely arrived at the designated pickup location at 08:43:00, prior to the 08:45:00 scheduled pickup time, as verified by system telemetry and arrival events. E-001 E-004 E-013 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.4
  • The driver fulfilled all pre-cancellation contact requirements under Section 2.3 by sending four in-app chat messages and placing an in-app phone call prior to trip cancellation. E-017 E-018 E-019 E-020 E-021 E-029 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.3
  • The driver waited past the required 5-minute free wait window ending at 08:50:00, with 360 seconds elapsed between the 08:45:00 scheduled pickup and the 08:51:00 cancellation. E-003 E-006 E-037 E-039 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.2
  • The driver remained stationary at the pickup coordinates across multiple recorded telemetry samples from 08:43:00 through 08:51:00, totaling 480 seconds from driver wait start. E-001 E-005 E-013 E-014 E-015 E-016 E-035 P-004 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.2
  • The rider stated they were waiting at the lobby and that the driver never appeared, but telemetry logs record the vehicle stationed at the pickup coordinates with automated arrival confirmed. E-001 E-002 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.4
  • While discrete GPS points at 08:43, 08:45, 08:48, and 08:51 record speed 0 km/h at the pickup location, they do not establish uninterrupted observation between sample timestamps. E-001
  • A conflict exists regarding whether the 8-minute no-show threshold in embedded policy starts from driver arrival or scheduled pickup, though the 5-minute free wait past scheduled pickup under v2.1 Section 2.1 was fully met. E-003 E-004 E-006 E-031 E-037 E-039 P-004 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1
  • Resolution of the policy conflict between embedded cancellation policy P-004 (8-minute threshold) and Ryde Policy v2.1 §2.1 (cancellation permitted after 5-minute free wait from scheduled pickup).
  • Specification of the triggering start event and policy clock for embedded policy rule P-004 (driver_arrival_time vs. scheduled_pickup_time).

回应对方

  • The driver timely arrived at 08:43:00, prior to the 08:45:00 scheduled pickup, with system telemetry recording the vehicle within 10 meters of the pickup point at 0 km/h and an automatic arrival notification sent to the rider. E-004 E-013 E-026 E-027 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.4
  • The driver fully met the pre-cancellation contact obligation under Section 2.3 by transmitting four in-app chat messages describing exact location and vehicle details and placing an in-app call ringing 22 seconds without answer. E-017 E-018 E-019 E-020 E-021 E-029 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.3
  • Under Policy v2.1 Section 2.1, the 5-minute free wait elapsed from scheduled pickup (08:45:00 to 08:50:00), making the 08:51:00 cancellation compliant as 360 seconds elapsed, thereby entitling the driver to the $5.00 fee under Section 2.2. E-003 E-006 E-008 E-037 E-039 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.2
  • Even under the 8-minute no-show threshold logged in app event E-031, exactly 480 seconds (8 full minutes) elapsed from the recorded driver wait start at 08:43:00 to cancellation at 08:51:00, confirming the driver waited 8 minutes at the pickup coordinates. E-001 E-005 E-006 E-013 E-014 E-015 E-016 E-031 E-035 P-001 P-002 P-004
  • While the rider reported waiting 10 minutes at the lobby without seeing the driver, recorded GPS samples and app events establish the driver was stopped within 10 meters of the pickup point from 08:43:00 through 08:51:00 and proactively messaged the vehicle description. E-001 E-002 E-018 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.4
  • The rider advocate asserts an unresolved conflict between the 8-minute embedded threshold and the 5-minute Section 2.1 rule; however, the driver satisfied both Section 2.1 (waiting past 5 minutes from scheduled pickup) and the app-triggered 8-minute threshold measured from wait start at 08:43:00. E-005 E-006 E-031 E-035 E-037 E-039 P-004 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1
  • Resolution of rule precedence between embedded policy P-004 (8-minute threshold) and Ryde Policy v2.1 Section 2.1 (5-minute free wait from scheduled pickup).
  • Explicit definition of the start event governing the 8-minute no-show threshold referenced in P-004 and app event E-031.
  • System confirmation of delivery and display status on the rider device for the driver's four in-app chat messages and arrival alert.

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §2.1 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/2.1",

    "value": {
      "title": "Free Wait Time",
      "text": "- The driver must wait at the pickup location for a **free wait time of 5 minutes** from the scheduled pickup time.\n- After 5 minutes, the driver may cancel the trip as a \"rider no-show.\"",
      "line_start": 41,
      "line_end": 44
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S2.2 Section 2.2: Cancellation Fee

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §2.2 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/2.2",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Cancellation Fee",
      "text": "- A **no-show cancellation fee of $5.00** is charged to the rider when the driver cancels after the free wait period.\n- The cancellation fee is transferred to the driver as compensation for time and fuel.",
      "line_start": 46,
      "line_end": 49
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S2.3 Section 2.3: Driver Contact Obligation

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §2.3 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/2.3",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Driver Contact Obligation",
      "text": "Before cancelling for no-show, the driver **MUST** attempt to contact the rider with:\n\n1. **At least 1 in-app chat message**, AND\n2. **At least 1 phone call** (via the in-app calling system).\n\nIf the driver fails to meet both contact obligations, the cancellation fee is **voided** and the rider is not charged.",
      "line_start": 51,
      "line_end": 58
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S2.4 Section 2.4: Driver No-Show

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §2.4 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/2.4",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Driver No-Show",
      "text": "- If the driver **fails to arrive at the pickup location** within a reasonable time (defined as scheduled pickup time + 5 minutes), the rider may cancel at no charge.\n- If the driver fails to arrive **and** fails to attempt contact, the rider is eligible for a **$5.00 goodwill credit**.",
      "line_start": 60,
      "line_end": 63
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S2.5 Section 2.5: Repeat No-Show Flagging

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §2.5 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/2.5",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Repeat No-Show Flagging",
      "text": "- If a rider accumulates **3 or more no-show cancellations within a 30-day rolling window**, the rider's account is **flagged** for review.\n- Flagged accounts are subject to:\n  - Mandatory upfront payment for future bookings.\n  - Temporary suspension pending review by the Trust & Safety team.",
      "line_start": 65,
      "line_end": 70
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S5.1 Section 5.1: Automatic Escalation

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.1 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/5.1",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Automatic Escalation",
      "text": "Any dispute flagged as **safety-related** is **automatically escalated to human review**. Safety-related disputes include but are not limited to:\n\n- Reckless or dangerous driving.\n- Physical or verbal harassment.\n- Assault or threat of assault.\n- Inappropriate behavior or conduct.\n- Traffic accidents during the trip.\n- Rider or driver feeling unsafe during the trip.",
      "line_start": 152,
      "line_end": 161
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S5.2 Section 5.2: AI Agent Limitations

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.2 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/5.2",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "AI Agent Limitations",
      "text": "- AI agents (Rider Advocate, Driver Advocate, Judge) **MAY** gather evidence, summarize accounts, and prepare case files for human reviewers.\n- AI agents **CANNOT** issue rulings, determine fault, or recommend resolutions on safety incidents.\n- AI agents **MUST** flag any dispute that contains safety-related keywords or indicators for immediate human escalation, regardless of the dispute type selected by the filer.",
      "line_start": 163,
      "line_end": 167
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S5.3 Section 5.3: Interim Measures

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.3 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/5.3",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Interim Measures",
      "text": "Upon escalation, the system may apply interim measures pending human review:\n\n- Temporary suspension of the accused party's account.\n- Prevention of new trip acceptance (for drivers) or booking (for riders).\n- These measures are lifted if the human reviewer determines no safety violation occurred.",
      "line_start": 169,
      "line_end": 175
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S6.1 Section 6.1: Monetary Thresholds

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.1 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/6.1",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Monetary Thresholds",
      "text": "| Dispute Value | Ruling Path | Agent Confidence Requirement |\n|---|---|---|\n| Under $10 | AI agent ruling is **final** | Any confidence level |\n| $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling with **80%+ confidence** | If confidence < 80%, escalate to human review |\n| Above $50 | **Always human review** | N/A — AI agent prepares case file only |",
      "line_start": 181,
      "line_end": 187
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2 Section 6.2: Category Thresholds

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.2 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/6.2",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Category Thresholds",
      "text": "| Dispute Category | Ruling Path |\n|---|---|\n| Safety incident | **Always human review** (see Section 5) |\n| Fare dispute < $10 | AI agent ruling is final |\n| Fare dispute $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80%, else escalate |\n| Fare dispute > $50 | Always human review |\n| Route deviation | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80% and deviation ≤ 2km, else escalate |\n| Property damage (cleaning ≤ $50) | AI agent ruling if photo evidence is verifiable |\n| Property damage (repair > $50) | Always human review |\n| No-show / cancellation | AI agent ruling is final (fee is fixed at $5.00) |",
      "line_start": 189,
      "line_end": 200
    }
  }
]

        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1",
          "rule": "Section 2.1: Free Wait Time\n- The driver must wait at the pickup location for a **free wait time of 5 minutes** from the scheduled pickup time.\n- After 5 minutes, the driver may cancel the trip as a \"rider no-show.\"",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §2.1"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S2.2",
          "rule": "Section 2.2: Cancellation Fee\n- A **no-show cancellation fee of $5.00** is charged to the rider when the driver cancels after the free wait period.\n- The cancellation fee is transferred to the driver as compensation for time and fuel.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §2.2"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S2.3",
          "rule": "Section 2.3: Driver Contact Obligation\nBefore cancelling for no-show, the driver **MUST** attempt to contact the rider with:\n\n1. **At least 1 in-app chat message**, AND\n2. **At least 1 phone call** (via the in-app calling system).\n\nIf the driver fails to meet both contact obligations, the cancellation fee is **voided** and the rider is not charged.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §2.3"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S2.4",
          "rule": "Section 2.4: Driver No-Show\n- If the driver **fails to arrive at the pickup location** within a reasonable time (defined as scheduled pickup time + 5 minutes), the rider may cancel at no charge.\n- If the driver fails to arrive **and** fails to attempt contact, the rider is eligible for a **$5.00 goodwill credit**.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §2.4"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S2.5",
          "rule": "Section 2.5: Repeat No-Show Flagging\n- If a rider accumulates **3 or more no-show cancellations within a 30-day rolling window**, the rider's account is **flagged** for review.\n- Flagged accounts are subject to:\n  - Mandatory upfront payment for future bookings.\n  - Temporary suspension pending review by the Trust & Safety team.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §2.5"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S5.1",
          "rule": "Section 5.1: Automatic Escalation\nAny dispute flagged as **safety-related** is **automatically escalated to human review**. Safety-related disputes include but are not limited to:\n\n- Reckless or dangerous driving.\n- Physical or verbal harassment.\n- Assault or threat of assault.\n- Inappropriate behavior or conduct.\n- Traffic accidents during the trip.\n- Rider or driver feeling unsafe during the trip.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.1"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S5.2",
          "rule": "Section 5.2: AI Agent Limitations\n- AI agents (Rider Advocate, Driver Advocate, Judge) **MAY** gather evidence, summarize accounts, and prepare case files for human reviewers.\n- AI agents **CANNOT** issue rulings, determine fault, or recommend resolutions on safety incidents.\n- AI agents **MUST** flag any dispute that contains safety-related keywords or indicators for immediate human escalation, regardless of the dispute type selected by the filer.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.2"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S5.3",
          "rule": "Section 5.3: Interim Measures\nUpon escalation, the system may apply interim measures pending human review:\n\n- Temporary suspension of the accused party's account.\n- Prevention of new trip acceptance (for drivers) or booking (for riders).\n- These measures are lifted if the human reviewer determines no safety violation occurred.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.3"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S6.1",
          "rule": "Section 6.1: Monetary Thresholds\n| Dispute Value | Ruling Path | Agent Confidence Requirement |\n|---|---|---|\n| Under $10 | AI agent ruling is **final** | Any confidence level |\n| $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling with **80%+ confidence** | If confidence < 80%, escalate to human review |\n| Above $50 | **Always human review** | N/A — AI agent prepares case file only |",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.1"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2",
          "rule": "Section 6.2: Category Thresholds\n| Dispute Category | Ruling Path |\n|---|---|\n| Safety incident | **Always human review** (see Section 5) |\n| Fare dispute < $10 | AI agent ruling is final |\n| Fare dispute $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80%, else escalate |\n| Fare dispute > $50 | Always human review |\n| Route deviation | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80% and deviation ≤ 2km, else escalate |\n| Property damage (cleaning ≤ $50) | AI agent ruling if photo evidence is verifiable |\n| Property damage (repair > $50) | Always human review |\n| No-show / cancellation | AI agent ruling is final (fee is fixed at $5.00) |",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.2"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S6.3",
          "rule": "Section 6.3: Confidence Calibration\n- Agent confidence is calculated based on: evidence completeness, policy clarity, precedent alignment, and party credibility scores.\n- If any party has a fraud flag ≥ 1, the confidence threshold is raised to 95% regardless of dispute value.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.3"
        },
        {

          "rule": "Section 7.3: No-Show Cancellation Without Contact Attempt\n| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Case ID** | DISP-2026-0211 |\n| **Date** | 2026-05-18 |\n| **Dispute Type** | cancellation_fee |\n| **Facts** | Driver arrived at pickup, waited 6 minutes, and cancelled as no-show. $5.00 fee charged to rider. The $5.00 fee is reversed and refunded to the rider. |\n| **Refund Amount** | $5.00 |\n| **Confidence** | 98% |",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §7.3"
        }
      ]

    "policy_documents": {
      "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1": {
        "document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
        "title": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1",
        "version": "2.1",
        "effective_date": "2026-01-01",
        "source": {
          "filename": "Document 2 — Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 (Markdown).md",
          "archive_path": "sources/official/2026-10-15/policy-v2.1.md",
          "file_sha256": "827c4d2cab2d4db9e176521000b079632bbe80c20f69c3ffd0addecc8cbc8699"
        },
        "sections": {
          "1.1": {
            "title": "General Principle",
            "text": "Drivers are permitted to reroute from the GPS-recommended path in response to real-time traffic conditions, road closures, or congestion. However, the rider must be informed of any deviation.",
            "line_start": 12,
            "line_end": 14
          },
          "1.2": {
            "title": "Notification Requirement",
            "text": "- The driver **MUST** inform the rider of a route deviation via **in-app chat** or **verbally** (with the trip call recording as evidence) **before or at the point of deviation**.\n- A brief reason (e.g., \"traffic jam ahead onNicoll Highway, taking alternate route\") is sufficient.",
            "line_start": 16,
            "line_end": 19
          },
          "1.3": {
            "title": "Refund Eligibility Matrix",
            "text": "| Scenario | Rider Informed? | Deviation > 1km? | Refund |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider informed and agrees | Yes | Yes | No refund |\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider **not** informed | No | Yes | Partial refund of excess distance fare |\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider not informed | No | No (≤ 1km) | No refund (within tolerance) |\n| Driver reroutes **without** traffic justification (no evidence of congestion) | N/A | Yes | **Full refund** of excess distance fare |\n| Driver reroutes without justification, deviation ≤ 1km | N/A | No | No refund (within tolerance) |",
            "line_start": 21,
            "line_end": 29
          },
          "1.4": {
            "title": "Evidence Requirements",
            "text": "- Traffic justification is verified via **historical traffic API data** for the route segment at the trip time.\n- Route deviation distance is calculated as: `actual_route_distance − recommended_route_distance`.\n- If the driver's in-app chat or call recording confirms rider acknowledgment, the deviation is considered agreed.",
            "line_start": 31,
            "line_end": 35
          },
          "2.1": {
            "title": "Free Wait Time",
            "text": "- The driver must wait at the pickup location for a **free wait time of 5 minutes** from the scheduled pickup time.\n- After 5 minutes, the driver may cancel the trip as a \"rider no-show.\"",
            "line_start": 41,
            "line_end": 44
          },
          "2.2": {
            "title": "Cancellation Fee",
            "text": "- A **no-show cancellation fee of $5.00** is charged to the rider when the driver cancels after the free wait period.\n- The cancellation fee is transferred to the driver as compensation for time and fuel.",
            "line_start": 46,
            "line_end": 49
          },
          "2.3": {
            "title": "Driver Contact Obligation",
            "text": "Before cancelling for no-show, the driver **MUST** attempt to contact the rider with:\n\n1. **At least 1 in-app chat message**, AND\n2. **At least 1 phone call** (via the in-app calling system).\n\nIf the driver fails to meet both contact obligations, the cancellation fee is **voided** and the rider is not charged.",
            "line_start": 51,
            "line_end": 58
          },
          "2.4": {
            "title": "Driver No-Show",
            "text": "- If the driver **fails to arrive at the pickup location** within a reasonable time (defined as scheduled pickup time + 5 minutes), the rider may cancel at no charge.\n- If the driver fails to arrive **and** fails to attempt contact, the rider is eligible for a **$5.00 goodwill credit**.",
            "line_start": 60,
            "line_end": 63
          },
          "2.5": {
            "title": "Repeat No-Show Flagging",
            "text": "- If a rider accumulates **3 or more no-show cancellations within a 30-day rolling window**, the rider's account is **flagged** for review.\n- Flagged accounts are subject to:\n  - Mandatory upfront payment for future bookings.\n  - Temporary suspension pending review by the Trust & Safety team.",
            "line_start": 65,
            "line_end": 70
          },
          "3.1": {
            "title": "Upfront Quote Binding",
            "text": "- The upfront quote presented to the rider at booking is **binding at the surge multiplier in effect at quote time** (typically 1.0x in normal conditions).\n- The quoted fare includes: base fare, distance fare, time fare, booking fee, and any applicable surge.",
            "line_start": 76,
            "line_end": 79
          },
          "3.2": {
            "title": "Surge Change Notification",
            "text": "- If the surge multiplier **increases** between the time of quote and the time of trip start, the rider **MUST be notified** via an **in-app notification** before or at the point of pickup.\n- The notification must clearly state:\n  - The new surge multiplier.\n  - The revised estimated fare.\n  - An option to cancel without penalty.",
            "line_start": 81,
            "line_end": 87
          },
          "3.3": {
            "title": "Refund Eligibility",
            "text": "| Scenario | Rider Notified? | Refund |\n|---|---|---|\n| Surge increases, rider notified, rider proceeds | Yes | No refund — higher fare applies |\n| Surge increases, rider **not** notified | No | **Full refund of the surge differential** (actual fare − quoted fare) |\n| Surge decreases between quote and trip start | N/A | Lower fare applies automatically (rider benefits) |\n| Surge unchanged | N/A | Quoted fare applies |",
            "line_start": 89,
            "line_end": 96
          },
          "3.4": {
            "title": "Surge Differential Calculation",
            "text": "```\nsurge_differential = actual_fare − upfront_quote\n```\n\nWhere the difference is attributable solely to a surge multiplier change (all other fare components unchanged), the full differential is refundable if the rider was not notified.",
            "line_start": 98,
            "line_end": 104
          },
          "3.5": {
            "title": "Surge-Exempt Components",
            "text": "The following fare components are **exempt** from surge pricing and remain fixed regardless of multiplier:\n\n- Booking fee\n\nAll other components (base fare, distance fare, time fare) are subject to the surge multiplier.",
            "line_start": 106,
            "line_end": 112
          },
          "4.1": {
            "title": "Driver Claim Rights",
            "text": "Drivers may file claims for cleaning or repair fees resulting from **rider-caused damage** to the vehicle, including but not limited to:\n\n- Spills, vomiting, or food/beverage stains.\n- Physical damage to interior (seats, doors, windows).\n- Damage to exterior caused by rider behavior during boarding/alighting.",
            "line_start": 118,
            "line_end": 124
          },
          "4.2": {
            "title": "Evidence Requirements",
            "text": "| Requirement | Details |\n|---|---|\n| Photo evidence | Must be submitted **within 24 hours** of trip completion |\n| Timestamps | Photos must be automatically timestamped by the in-app camera |\n| Verifiability | Photos must be verifiable — taken through the Ryde driver app's built-in camera, not external uploads |\n| Trip association | Damage must be linked to the specific trip via GPS telemetry and trip timestamp |",
            "line_start": 126,
            "line_end": 133
          },
          "4.3": {
            "title": "Fee Structure",
            "text": "| Damage Type | Maximum Fee | Conditions |\n|---|---|---|\n| Cleaning fee | Up to **$50.00** | Photo evidence of soiling/stain; no external quote required |\n| Repair fee | Cost of repair | Requires a **written quote from a certified workshop**; quote must be submitted within 7 days |",
            "line_start": 135,
            "line_end": 140
          },
          "4.4": {
            "title": "Dispute Handling",
            "text": "- If the rider disputes the damage claim, the dispute is routed to human review.\n- The driver's photo evidence and the rider's account are both reviewed.\n- If evidence is insufficient (no timestamp, external photo, or damage not linked to trip), the claim is **rejected**.",
            "line_start": 142,
            "line_end": 146
          },
          "5.1": {
            "title": "Automatic Escalation",
            "text": "Any dispute flagged as **safety-related** is **automatically escalated to human review**. Safety-related disputes include but are not limited to:\n\n- Reckless or dangerous driving.\n- Physical or verbal harassment.\n- Assault or threat of assault.\n- Inappropriate behavior or conduct.\n- Traffic accidents during the trip.\n- Rider or driver feeling unsafe during the trip.",
            "line_start": 152,
            "line_end": 161
          },
          "5.2": {
            "title": "AI Agent Limitations",
            "text": "- AI agents (Rider Advocate, Driver Advocate, Judge) **MAY** gather evidence, summarize accounts, and prepare case files for human reviewers.\n- AI agents **CANNOT** issue rulings, determine fault, or recommend resolutions on safety incidents.\n- AI agents **MUST** flag any dispute that contains safety-related keywords or indicators for immediate human escalation, regardless of the dispute type selected by the filer.",
            "line_start": 163,
            "line_end": 167
          },
          "5.3": {
            "title": "Interim Measures",
            "text": "Upon escalation, the system may apply interim measures pending human review:\n\n- Temporary suspension of the accused party's account.\n- Prevention of new trip acceptance (for drivers) or booking (for riders).\n- These measures are lifted if the human reviewer determines no safety violation occurred.",
            "line_start": 169,
            "line_end": 175
          },
          "6.1": {
            "title": "Monetary Thresholds",
            "text": "| Dispute Value | Ruling Path | Agent Confidence Requirement |\n|---|---|---|\n| Under $10 | AI agent ruling is **final** | Any confidence level |\n| $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling with **80%+ confidence** | If confidence < 80%, escalate to human review |\n| Above $50 | **Always human review** | N/A — AI agent prepares case file only |",
            "line_start": 181,
            "line_end": 187
          },
          "6.2": {
            "title": "Category Thresholds",

      已记录的依据

      • The surge multiplier increased from 1.0x at quote time to 1.5x at trip start, and the system log explicitly records that the rider was not notified (rider_notified=false). Under Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 Sections 3.1, 3.2, 3.3, and 3.4, the rider is entitled to a full refund of the surge differential of $4.50 (actual fare $16.50 minus quoted fare $12.00), while the driver retains the baseline quoted fare of $12.00 for the completed service.

        以下为通过结构和引用检查的分析；这些检查不能证明自然语言推理正确。

        核心问题

        Whether the rider is entitled to a refund of the $4.50 fare difference when the surge multiplier increased from 1.0x to 1.5x prior to trip start without in-app notification to the rider under Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 Sections 3.1–3.5.

        乘客观点 · 部分有依据支持

        Program summary of the retained per-argument assessments; see each original argument and its evidence. The original model summary is retained in the adjustment audit.

        裁决关键条件

        • fare_charge · 不满足

          The upfront quote of $12.00 is binding, and the actual fare charged of $16.50 contains an unnotified surge differential that cannot be upheld under Section 3.1 and Section 3.3.

          E-001 E-015 E-016 E-017 E-018 E-019 E-020 E-021 E-022 E-023 E-024 E-025 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.5
        • surge_components · 满足

          The entire $4.50 difference between the actual fare and upfront quote is attributable solely to the surge multiplier increasing from 1.0x to 1.5x on a constant surgeable subtotal of $9.00 with booking fee surge-exempt.

          E-015 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.5
        • surge_timing · 满足

          The 1.5x surge multiplier activated at 21:04:30, prior to the recorded trip start at 21:05:00.

          E-017 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3
        • surge_notice · 不满足

          The platform surge pricing log explicitly confirms rider_notified=false with null notification method and timestamp, violating the mandatory in-app notification requirement of Section 3.2.

          E-017 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3

        争议点分析

        • Entitlement to refund of the $4.50 surge differential due to lack of rider notification

          Under Section 3.2, an increase in surge multiplier between quote and trip start requires in-app notification before or at pickup. System records show surge increased from 1.0x to 1.5x at 21:04:30 and rider_notified=false. Section 3.3 mandates a full refund of the surge differential ($4.50) when the rider is not notified.

          E-015 E-017 E-021 E-022 E-023 E-024 E-025 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.5
        • Scope of refund versus driver base compensation

          Both parties agree that the transportation service was completed from Bugis Junction to Marina Bay Sands in 13 minutes. Refunding only the $4.50 surge differential preserves the upfront binding quote of $12.00, satisfying Sections 3.1 and 3.4.

          E-010 E-011 E-016 E-017 E-018 E-020 E-021 E-022 E-025 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4

          先例对照

          • P-RYDE-2.1-S7.2

            相似点：In DISP-2026-0142, the surge multiplier increased between quote and pickup without rider notification, and the entire fare difference was attributable solely to the surge multiplier change, resulting in a full refund of the surge differential.

            差异：In DISP-2026-0142, the quote was $9.50 at 1.0x and actual fare was $12.70 at 1.4x (differential $3.20), whereas in this case the quote was $12.00 at 1.0x and actual fare was $16.50 at 1.5x (differential $4.50).

            • The surge pricing log explicitly records rider_notified=false with null notification timestamp and method when surge activated at 2026-09-14T21:04:30+08:00 prior to trip start. E-017 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2
            • Under Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 Section 3.3 and Section 3.4, when a surge multiplier increases without required rider notification, the rider is eligible for a full refund of the surge differential ($4.50). E-015 E-023 E-024 E-025 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4

              回应对方

              • The rider reported receiving an upfront quote of $12.00 at booking and stated they were charged $16.50 without prior notice of any surge or price adjustment before or during the ride. E-002 E-012 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1
              • Platform records confirm that the upfront quote was $12.00 at a 1.0x multiplier, but the actual fare charged was $16.50 following a mid-dispatch surge increase to 1.5x at 21:04:30. E-015 E-021 E-022 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1
              • The surge pricing log explicitly records rider_notified=false with null notification method and timestamp, establishing an unnotified surge increase under Section 3.2. E-017 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2
              • The entire $4.50 discrepancy is arithmetically attributable solely to the surge multiplier increase with fixed surge-exempt components, entitling the rider to a full refund of the $4.50 surge differential pursuant to Section 3.3 and Section 3.4. E-015 E-023 E-025 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.5
              • While the driver correctly notes that the transportation service was completed from pickup to drop-off, completed transit does not override the binding quote or policy requirement to notify the rider of surge increases prior to pickup. E-016 E-017 E-018 E-020 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2
              • The driver side acknowledges that under Section 3.3 the remedy for an unnotified surge increase is a refund of the $4.50 surge differential, which directly supports granting the rider's requested remedy. E-002 E-024 E-025 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4
